name: Thorlan04 EU B2B Compliance, VIES VAT, SIRET & Shopify JSON MCP Suite
description: Model Context Protocol server suite providing French SIREN/SIRET validation, EU VIES VAT verification, GDPR & EAA 2025 website compliance audits, zero-proxy Shopify products.json catalog monitoring, and clean RAG Markdown extraction.

tools.name: audit_eu_b2b_compliance
tools.description: Verifies European company legal identifiers (French SIREN/SIRET, EU VIES VAT) and audits the target domain for GDPR privacy compliance, European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025 / WCAG 2.1 AA) readiness, and llms.txt AI search optimization.

targetUrl.description: Company website URL to inspect (e.g. https://www.example.fr).

siretOrSiren.description: Optional 9-digit SIREN or 14-digit SIRET number to verify.

vatNumber.description: Optional EU intra-community VAT number (e.g. FRXX123456789) for VIES validation.

checkVies.description: Validate extracted or provided VAT numbers against the EU VIES registry.

checkEaa.description: Evaluate European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025 / WCAG 2.1 AA) compliance signals.

checkGdpr.description: Audit GDPR legal mentions, privacy policy links, and cookie consent banners.

tools.name: scrape_shopify_catalog_json
tools.description: Extracts complete product catalogs, variant pricing, SKUs, and real-time stock availability from any Shopify store using fast public JSON endpoints.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: Base URL of the Shopify store (e.g. https://gymshark.com).

maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to retrieve (supports full pagination).

collection.description: Optional Shopify collection handle to filter products.

tools.name: execute_b2b_autopilot_pipeline
tools.description: Executes an autonomous B2B workflow: clean RAG Markdown extraction, llms.txt manifest generation, EU B2B compliance audit, or Shopify catalog monitoring.
